entities.summary: Adrian Andreev is a Bulgarian professional tennis player, who competes mainly on the ATP Challenger Tour. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of World No. 183 achieved on 18 September 2023. He won the 2018 US Open Junior doubles title with Anton Matusevich. 2 on 31 December 2018.
